title: Sevendust
body:
Sevendust is an act Dan Frank saw live 2 times between 2002-2004, per the concert log he kept (preserved in the corpus). This page records those appearances and the details attached to each in the source.

## Live appearances

All dates, venues, cities, and notes below are taken from the source table and preserved in full, including tentative or unconfirmed items.

| Date | Show / Context | Venue | City | Note |
|------|---------------|-------|------|------|
| Jul 27, 2002 | Rolling Rock Town Fair | Westmoreland Fairgrounds | Latrobe / Mt. Pleasant, PA | Alien Ant Farm cancelled (bus accident); Tommy Lee filled in. |
| Jul 31, 2004 | Rolling Rock Town Fair | Westmoreland Fairgrounds | Latrobe / Mt. Pleasant, PA | Heavy rain/mud reported; no postponement found. |

## Notes per appearance

- **Jul 27, 2002** — Rolling Rock Town Fair, Westmoreland Fairgrounds, Latrobe / Mt. Pleasant, PA. Alien Ant Farm cancelled (bus accident); Tommy Lee filled in.
- **Jul 31, 2004** — Rolling Rock Town Fair, Westmoreland Fairgrounds, Latrobe / Mt. Pleasant, PA. Heavy rain/mud reported; no postponement found.
